title: Production Tool: shared definitions
description: Types every other contract uses. Contract version 2 (2026-10-07, canvas-solid-refs: keys and variants replace the character views; combine folds into generate).

sha256.description: Content address of an artifact: the SHA-256 of its bytes. Authoritative; every URL is only a hint.

id.description: Prefixed ULID made by the client: job_…, ref_…, node_…, shot_…, frame_…, take_…, rev_…, pin_…

tag.description: A ref's wire name inside one provider job, in the strictest form any provider accepts (Runway: 3-16 chars). The relay derives it from the ref's name (relay/names.py) and rewrites @name in the job's words to it; adapters rewrite it again into each provider's syntax.

key.description: A solid reference key: one character or object (maya, lamp). Lowercase letters and digits only: the underscore separates key from variant.

variant.description: Free text after the key: front, side, laughing, red-coat. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The turnaround views are the variants front, three-quarter, side and back.

refName.description: key_variant, as the participant writes it after @ (maya_laughing). Unique in a document.

refRole.description: What a key contributes. A character key goes to Runway as subject human and to fal as one Kling element (its front plus up to 3 other variants); every other role goes as an object/image ref.

view.description: op view: the turnaround view to make from the source image. It is also the variant the result is named by (maya_three-quarter).

region.description: A box in 0-1 coordinates of the image it sits on, origin top-left.

op.description: generate: one new image from 1-14 selected canvas nodes (drawings exported as the sketch, text as the instruction, pictures as refs). view: one turnaround view from a source image. shot_list: script to shots (director only, no provider). frame: one storyboard frame. region_edit: edit inside a region of a still. clip: frame to video. clip_edit: region comment or feel change on a clip. stitch: shots to one MP4 with the end card.

quotaClass.description: image: generate, view, frame, region_edit. video: clip, clip_edit. render: stitch. text: shot_list.

jobState.description: The job states of the repo's production pipeline contract (app/templates/advertising-studio/app/pipeline.yaml), borrowed for their uncertain state. uncertain: the provider may have accepted the job with no id recorded; reconciled by querying, never by paying again.

cost.description: Three separate numbers, never inferred from each other. confirmed stays absent and unknown true until the provider reports it.

assetRef.description: An artifact passed between browser, relay and provider. url is our CloudFront input path from POST /uploads.

output.description: One result of a job, already copied into our S3 (the provider URL is never handed out).

message.description: One line a participant can read in the node.

providerCode.description: The provider's own code, e.g. SAFETY.INPUT.TEXT or content_policy_violation. For logs.
